title: Symbols
subtitle: Manage tradable instruments, profiles, and broker aliases
instruction1: Add, enable, or edit trading symbols. Edits hot-reload across BotManager without restart.
instruction2: Validate the broker alias before enabling — the bot queries MT5 Bridge for lot limits, digits, and contract size.
instruction3: New symbols need ML training before they can trade. Click Retrain to queue a training job.
deleteConfirm: Delete {symbol}? This disables the symbol and removes it from the active list.
emptyDescription: Click "Add Symbol" to create the first trading instrument.
dialogEditDesc: Update trading profile. Changes apply immediately via hot-reload.
dialogAddDesc: Create a new symbol profile. Validate the broker alias before enabling.

form.errAliasFirst: Enter a symbol or broker alias first
form.labelMlSl: ML SL pips (training label only, currently ignored)
form.catalogUnavailable: Broker catalog unavailable{error}. Symbols cannot be added while the broker cannot be verified.
form.pickFromBroker: Pick from the broker catalog (validates and auto-fills fields)
form.searchPh: Search symbol or description (e.g. ENJ, gold, Apple)
form.symbolAutoDerived: Canonical name is derived server-side from broker symbol "{broker}"
form.brokerValidated: Broker symbol selected — existence and tradability are verified live on create
form.previewClamp: Stop distance will be clamped to {bounds}
form.previewRr: TP = {ratio} × actual stop distance (R held constant)
